title: Release train weekly gap analysis and hotfix queue
content:
Meeting: Release Engineering weekly — gap analysis + hotfix queue sync
Date: 2026-02-24 (notes updated 2026-03-10)
Owner: Marc Nguyen
Attendees: Marc N., Aisha P., Sophie A., Ethan B., Ravi S., (ops: Lina C. joined for Hotfix A2)

Purpose
- Run a focused gap analysis comparing scheduled release train outcomes to target SLOs (lead time, rollback rate, deploy success).
- Triage hotfix queue and confirm owners / SLAs for each active hotfix.
- Decide short-term adjustments to release cadence and on-call rotation for the next 4 weeks.

Agenda
1) Quick run through of last train (2026-02-20 -> 2026-02-24) metrics
2) Hotfix queue triage (priority, owner, ETA)
3) Gap analysis: where we missed expectations and root causes
4) Operational changes proposal (staging freeze windows, release gate checklist tweaks, rotation change)
5) Action items and owners

1) Train metrics highlights
- Deploys attempted: 38 (scheduled: 40)
- Successful deploys without rollback: 34 (target >= 95% success; actual 89.5%)
- Mean lead time (PR merged -> prod): 6.8 hours (target: < 4h for high-priority routes)
- Average time-to-fix for post-deploy incidents: 2.9 hours (target <= 2h)
- Canary deviation observed: 1.6% higher error rate on region-eu-prod for sequence ops during 09:00-10:30 PT window
Notes: The major variance came from two rollbacks caused by an unpinned dependency in model-serving image and a late config tweak that bypassed the rollout guard.

2) Hotfix queue snapshot (as of 2026-02-24)
- HF-A2 (priority: P0) — "kv-cache invalidation on long-tail keys" — Owner: Aisha Patel — ETA: 2026-02-24 16:00 PT (deployed 18:45 PT; rollback not required; verify in next 24h) — Linked: JIRA-RELEASE-412
- HF-B1 (priority: P1) — "observability agent crash on dedicated nodes when batch size=0" — Owner: Ethan Brooks — ETA: 2026-02-26 — Mitigation: node drain + kill-loop patch in draft PR (github.com/redwood-inference/release-scripts/pull/87)
- HF-C3 (priority: P2) — "dashboard sampling mismatch for route /v1/chat" — Owner: Ravi Shah — ETA: 2026-03-02 — Low user impact, monitoring alert only
Notes: Confirmed SLA for P0 = 6h, P1 = 48h, P2 = 7 days. Aisha to post final postmortem for HF-A2 by 2026-02-26.

3) Gap analysis (why metrics missed targets)
- Root cause 1: Unpinned base images in the build pipeline allowed a transient library bump. Recommendation: enforce image pinning and add asm-smoke step in CI that runs a small inference surface test against a canary image before the build publishes. (Owner: Release infra, action below)
- Root cause 2: Late config push bypassed rollout guard. The config owner (service-config team) updated a service flag directly in prod to address sampling, but bypassed the gate. Recommendation: add a hard block that requires a release-ticket for any config changes during a 2-hour canary window. (Owner: Product infra)
- Root cause 3: On-call fatigue and handoff ambiguity during holiday week — discovered missing explicit rotation swap in the calendar (two swaps were left unacknowledged). Recommendation: formalize weekly rotation handoff doc and require explicit ACK in Slack. (Owner: Eng ops)

4) Proposed operational changes (votes and immediate next steps)
- Proposal A: Two-week pilot — enforce image pinning + asm-smoke in CI. (Vote: 5/5 approve) — Implementation owner: Sophie Alvarez — ETA: 2026-03-03 for pilot config
- Proposal B: Release gate change — disallow direct prod-only config toggles during a canary window; require release ticket and two approvers. (Vote: 5/5 approve) — Implementation owner: Ravi Shah — ETA: 2026-02-28
- Proposal C: Rotation change — create a rotating 7-day "release duty" with explicit Friday-to-Friday handoff; include a short checklist and Slack ACK. (Vote: 4/5 approve, Marc requested a follow-up calendar automation) — Owner: Ethan Brooks — ETA: 2026-03-01 to publish calendar + automation ticket
- Proposal D: Hotfix triage playbook (working draft) — quick triage matrix and template for postmortems; keep P0 template under 6h resolution protocol. (Status: draft; Owner: Aisha Patel)

5) Risk register (short list)
- Risk: Increasing rollbacks if unpinned images persist — Mitigation: block image publish until asm-smoke passes.
- Risk: Manual config bypasses during off-hours — Mitigation: require release-ticket enforcement + 2 approvers.
- Risk: Capacity contention on dedicated clusters during end-of-week batches — Mitigation: pre-schedule heavy batch jobs to off-peak, alerting on queue depth > 75%.

Action items (owner -> deliverable -> due)
- Sophie Alvarez -> Implement asm-smoke CI job and image pin enforcement -> 2026-03-03
- Ravi Shah -> Add release-ticket enforcement for config changes + update rollout guard -> 2026-02-28
- Ethan Brooks -> Publish release duty calendar automation and handoff checklist -> 2026-03-01
- Aisha Patel -> Postmortem HF-A2 and finalize P0 hotfix playbook -> 2026-02-26
- Marc Nguyen -> Coordinate on-call overlap for the holiday week and confirm calendar ACK procedure -> 2026-02-27
- Release infra -> Add pre-publish check that references the canary cluster health API -> 2026-03-05

Open questions / discussion points
- Do we want to expand the canary window from 30 to 90 minutes for model-serving changes? (Pros: more signal; Cons: longer exposure) — deferred to next week, include SRE input.
- Should hotfix prioritization use a single unified queue (current) or split by region-critical vs global-impact? (Action: Ethan to draft a decision doc by 2026-03-04)

Notes to reviewers
- This doc is intentionally focused on operational gaps rather than full release narrative — full train report will be uploaded to Confluence (linked above) with per-ticket timelines and raw prometheus dashboards.
- If you want higher-frequency standups during high-risk windows, propose cadence in the Slack thread #release-ops.

Appendix (short snippets)
- Quick check command for canary health we agreed to standardize: curl -sS "https://canary-eu.redwood-inference.internal/health?scope=mini" | jq .status
- HF-A2 post-deploy verification checklist (short):
  1) Smoke keyspace checks (100 random keys)
  2) KV cache hit ratio compare (+/- 0.5%)
  3) Error rate (5m rolling) < baseline + 2x stddev

Next sync: 2026-03-03 (standup will be the usual 09:30 PT, followed by ad-hoc triage if a P0 exists)
